changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO role_edit_other_permissions (role_id, edit_other_permissions) SELECT edit_role.role_id, 19 FROM role_edit_other_permissions edit_role JOIN role_view_permissions view_role ON view_role.role_id = edit_role.role_id AND view_role.view_permissions = 17 JOIN role_view_other_permissions view_other_role ON view_other_role.role_id = edit_role.role_id AND view_other_role.view_other_permissions = 17 WHERE edit_role.edit_other_permissions = 17 ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
